llm.summary: This looks like a real website-building/deployment skill, but it under-declares sensitive credentials and advertises automatic deployment plus payment/admin capabilities without clear approval boundaries in the provided artifacts.

dimensions.detail: The described capabilities—website generation, EdgeOne Pages deployment, e-commerce, AI chat, and admin backend—fit the stated purpose, but they are high-impact because they can publish a site and affect business/payment data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill advertises automatic deployment and includes payment, order, and admin CRUD flows; the provided artifact excerpt does not show clear confirmation, rollback, or scoping requirements before publishing or mutating business data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files to review; the skill is instruction-only while describing many generated files and functions, so the deployed implementation would need separate review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md declares secret environment variables for JWT signing, AI API use, payment, and database access, but the registry requirements shown say there are no required env vars or credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The architecture uses KV sessions, AI history, localStorage, and deployed serverless functions. That is plausible for this purpose, but users should review retention and access boundaries.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Use staging deployments first, provide only least-privilege project-scoped credentials, do not provide production payment/database secrets until you have inspected the generated code, and require explicit confirmation before any public deployment or payment/admin functionality is enabled.

evidence.explanation: The skill declares sensitive signing, AI, payment, and database credentials, while the supplied registry requirements say no env vars or primary credential are required. That under-declares the permission boundary users would need to grant.
evidence.snippet:
env:
  JWT_SECRET:
    required: true
    secret: true
  AI_API_KEY:
    required: false
    secret: true
  WX_APPID ... WX_MCHID ... DATABASE_URL ... secret: true

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Declare these credentials in registry metadata and use only project-scoped, least-privilege secrets; users should avoid production payment/database credentials until the generated app is reviewed.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A user may install or invoke the skill without realizing it can require sensitive project, payment, and database secrets.

evidence.explanation: The skill combines automatic public deployment with payment, order, and admin mutation capabilities. These are purpose-aligned, but the provided text does not make user approval, environment scoping, or reversibility visible.
evidence.snippet: AI 生成完整前后端网站，自动部署到 EdgeOne Pages ... Cloud Functions ... Payment 创建/回调、Admin CRUD、Orders 创建/取消

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Require explicit user confirmation before deployment, payment setup, or admin/data mutations, and prefer preview/staging deployments before production.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If followed too aggressively, the agent could publish generated code or create business/payment/admin functionality before the user has reviewed it.

evidence.explanation: The instruction file describes a large generated project tree, but the provided manifest contains only SKILL.md and no code files. This is not malicious by itself, but the actual generated code and templates are not statically reviewable here.
evidence.snippet: templates/ ... client/ ... middleware.js ... edge-functions/ ... cloud-functions/ ... references/

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review generated files, dependencies, and deployment settings before publishing; pin dependencies and avoid deploying unreviewed generated backend/payment code.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Static scanning cannot validate the generated payment, authentication, admin, or deployment code before the agent creates it.

evidence.explanation: The architecture stores sessions, rate-limit state, AI history, and client-side data. That is expected for a full-stack site, but it introduces persistence and data-retention considerations.
evidence.snippet: KV session 验证 ... KV 限流计数器 ... AI History 读 ... localStorage 封装

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Define retention, deletion, and access rules for KV/session/AI-history storage, and avoid storing secrets or sensitive personal data in localStorage.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: User sessions, chat history, and client-side state may persist beyond a single interaction or deployment.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill’s automatic deployment plus payment/admin/order mutation scope needs explicit user approval and review controls.

permission_boundary.summary: Sensitive credentials are declared inside SKILL.md but not reflected in the supplied registry requirements.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The design includes persistent sessions, AI history, and localStorage, which are expected but should have clear retention and access rules.
